result.summary: The page has two visible content/layout glitches: an awkward redundant 'delivery' label in a popular restaurant's metadata and a clipped restaurant name in the fastest carousel.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar displays '25-35 min delivery · Ramen', where the word 'delivery' appears redundant and breaks the expected 'time · cuisine' format.
issues.suggestion: Remove the extra 'delivery' text so the line reads '25-35 min · Ramen' and keep delivery-fee information in its own badge or line.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows the restaurant name 'Trattoria Picco' clipped at the right edge without an ellipsis, suggesting the text overflows its container.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow ellipsis, increase the card width, or allow the title to wrap to a second line to avoid abrupt clipping.
